commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "a353ec9196220aa9729230d30fedb89cf01b330d" || exit 3
dest="$HOME/Downloads/Local-Agent-Chat-Bridge-0.8.15-GitHub-first"
backup="$HOME/.local/share/local-agent/fabric-bridge-backups/pre-0817"
test -d "$dest"
test "$(python3 -c 'import json;print(json.load(open("chat_bridge/manifest.json"))["version"])')" = "0.8.17"
test "$(python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["version"])' "$dest/manifest.json")" = "0.8.16"
mkdir -p "$backup"
for f in worker_github_fabric_private_live.js manifest.json; do
  test -f "$dest/$f"
  cp -p "$dest/$f" "$backup/$f"
  cp -p "chat_bridge/$f" "$dest/$f"
  cmp -s "chat_bridge/$f" "$dest/$f"
done
echo "BRIDGE_0817_SAME_DIRECTORY_STAGED; CHROME_NOT_RELOADED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
